evidence: Modifies GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/ci.yml, custom actions) and CI runner scripts under ci/ to cache and share qa-assets across CI jobs.
rationale: Reduces intermittent CI timeouts by fetching test assets once per workflow run rather than per job. While fixing CI reliability issues is valued in Build and CI, the issue is relatively infrequent (noted as occurring only in two PRs over the past year), making the improvement worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
